## Rules

- Exact fixture roles/proofs are §3. Each is its own Composer package and `ThirdParty\\` namespace. Imports must be listed by the installed archive's API map. Contract-suite success never replaces the point-specific behavior assertion.

## Guidance

Install the candidate repository into a new temp consumer per fixture. Run the framework-neutral helper, then one observable operation. Insert/remove the Internal import in `try/finally`; assert the diagnostic names both fixture and forbidden symbol.
